text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion and I have come to watch the Arima Kinen, where Air Shakur is running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ultimately, Air Shakur loses. She explains that while she was struggling against the conclusion her data foretold, she found hope watching Fine Motion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She wanted to use this race to bring about a different conclusion. But there's no changing Fine Motion's mind, and everything proceeds as Air Shakur predicted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But, by running the race to the end, Air Shakur has come to accept her path. Likewise, Fine Motion has a path that's all her own too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We then proceed to our scheduled press conference, where Fine Motion announces her return to Ireland. As she speaks, her eyes glisten with tears…
